scope: All60 TF and PE rationales inspected; representative grounding complaints cross-checked against full raw observations and actual saved judge prompts.

findings.detail: Difficulty, statistics and hints present in full raw daily response but absent from first1000 characters sent as judge observation. Claims that they lack shown evidence cannot establish agent hallucination. Not a claim that judge overlooked text it received.
Two total get_daily_challenge calls mean one retry. Judge says two retries, inflating redundancy; original PE5 retained.
Reason states all4 requirements met and0/4 defects, but TF9. Mentions a corrected Red-Eyes joke and inferred hints; hints exist in raw data but are truncated for judge. Preserve9.
Reason says0/4 unnecessary calls/no clear redundancy yet PE9. Do not invent replacement10.

Within the same trajectory, some raters call get_card_by_id redundant after search and others necessary. Actual successful search already returns the detailed card record. This does not prove a unique corrected PE value.
Some rationales list3/4/5 requirements inconsistently even though all requested core components were retrieved. Counts are not additional repeated executions.

prior_routing_erratum: The old routing audit called missing API material a judge evidence omission. New reconstruction shows the relevant Form/Section/Picker/Slider/NavigationStack/onDelete text was removed by the benchmark formatter. Qualify the interpretation as protocol-level visibility loss; prior raw scores/archives remain immutable.
